prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet is ready to leap onto your desktop screen!", "How to Interact with Your Pet", "Drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click to open quick actions or hide your pet anytime.", "Got It! Launch Pet"]
1: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Select whether to adopt an instant companion or create a custom pet from your photos.", "Instant Adoption vs Custom Pet Creation"]
2: ["Upload Pet Photos", "Upload clear photos of your pet for best custom generation results.", "Photo Quality Verification", "We checked your photos! Well-lit front-facing photos yield the best 3D pet model.", "Looks Good, Continue"]
3: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "Our rendering engine is building your desktop pet companion.", "Rendering pet assets"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Sign in with your existing account to instantly recover your pets and sync your setup across devices.", "Already created a pet before? Sign in with your original account to restore your pet automatically."]
5: ["Generating Your Pet in Background", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will notify you as soon as your pet appears on screen.", "Safe to Minimize"]
6: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Adopt a lively pet that sits on your desktop, reacts to your workday, and keeps you company while taking minimal system resources.", "Start Adoption", "Lightweight & Non-Intrusive"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new pet a name and choose their personality traits before they join your desktop.", "Pet Name", "Personality Trait"]
8: ["Save Your New Pet Companion", "Create an account or sign in now to save your pet's memory and settings permanently."]
9: ["Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Screen!", "Look around your screen to find your pet walking around.", "Can't see your pet? Check your system tray or click the tray icon to bring your pet to the front layer."]
